svg.title: Savanna in Transition: Southern Kebbi land-cover change, 2000 to 2026
svg.desc: By Satwik K Udupi (JRF, CCCSS, SUK · PravahaTattva Solutions, Karad) in collaboration with Yazid Abubakar Fakai, PhD Scholar. The mosaic is the real classified land-cover map of Southern Kebbi, Nigeria; cells that changed class fade between their 2000 and 2026 classes.
svg.text: Land-cover change, canopy loss and multi-sensor validation
across 12,294 km² of the Sudan–Guinea savanna.
● By Satwik K Udupi · JRF, CCCSS, SUK · PravahaTattva Solutions, Karad
● In collaboration with Yazid Abubakar Fakai · PhD Scholar
